subject: [PATCH 35/60] mm/mempolicy: keep private nodes out of migrate_pages() destinations

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: The original author posted a duplicate message via B4 Relay, which was likely an error. The actual discussion has not begun yet.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series addresses issues in the migration of pages between nodes, focusing on private nodes and their interaction with the cpuset. The patch specifically targets the `migrate_pages()` function, ensuring that it does not attempt to migrate pages to private nodes. This is achieved by modifying the destination mask to exclude private nodes.
